rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when one light, person, or performance visibly eclipses another.

example.english: The fireworks show outshine all the other acts tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚個煙花匯演蓋過晒其他節目的風頭。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go3 jin1 faa1 wui6 jin2 goi3 gwo3 saai3 kei4 taa1 zit3 muk6 dik1 fung1 tau4

rows.note: Use this specifically to say that one light or shining object is brighter than A.

example.english: The searchlight can outshine the moonlight and light up the whole street.
example.traditional: 個探射燈照得光過月光，成條街都白晒。
example.jyutping: go3 taam3 se6 dang1 ziu3 dak1 gwong1 gwo3 jyut6 gwong1 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 baak6 saai3

rows.note: Use this when a person steals the spotlight or attracts more attention than someone else.

example.english: Ming manages to outshine the lead the moment he gets on stage.
example.traditional: 阿明一上台就搶晒風頭，搞到主角冇人理。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jat1 soeng5 toi4 zau6 coeng2 saai3 fung1 tau4 gaau2 dou3 zyu2 gok3 mou5 jan4 lei5
